brief_requirements_rechecked_on_the_real.seen: At 1.5 s (full size 1920x1080) the disk is a rigid square translucent-red shell with a white factory label. The label reads '2HD' and 'IBM' clearly, and '1.44 MB' less sharply; a black logo block on the label is unreadable. Through the shell the metal hub with its centre hole and drive-pin slot is visible. No flexible sleeve, no large exposed hub ring, no oval head window in the shell face - it is not 5.25-inch or 8-inch media. '2HD' and '1.44' are the 3.5-inch high-density designations.

brief_requirements_rechecked_on_the_real.requirement: drive is a matching 3.5-inch drive, not 5.25-inch
brief_requirements_rechecked_on_the_real.seen: At 3.0 s and 6.0 s (full size) the drive is a bare beige 3.5-inch mechanism: one narrow horizontal slot whose width matches the disk, a small rectangular push-button eject at the right end of the bezel and a small indicator window at the left. There is no 5.25-inch rotating latch lever or door. The disk is swallowed fully by the slot with only a red sliver showing at 6.0 s, which a 5.25-inch bay would not do.

brief_requirements_rechecked_on_the_real.requirement: insertion direction is possible (shutter first, label side up)
brief_requirements_rechecked_on_the_real.verdict: PASS on label-side-up (directly observed); shutter-first still INFERRED, not directly seen
brief_requirements_rechecked_on_the_real.seen: Label side up is directly observed: at 1.5 s the printed label faces the camera on a drive lying flat, and the hub is visible only as a silhouette through the translucent shell, i.e. on the underside. Shutter-first remains inferred because the metal shutter is never in view in any sampled frame - at 0.95 s the leading edge is motion-blurred, from 1.5 s onward it is already inside the slot, and during the 8.6 s withdrawal it is still inside the drive. Two direct observations support the inference: (1) at 2.2 s the exposed trailing edge is bare red plastic with an open square through-hole at its corner and no metal shutter, and on a 3.5-inch disk the write-protect and HD-detect holes sit on the edge opposite the shutter; (2) the head-access window silhouette visible through the shell at 1.5 s lies on the half of the disk that goes into the drive - it is absent from the trailing half exposed during the 8.6 s withdrawal - which places the window, and therefore the shutter, on the leading edge.

'IBM' is readable at full size at 1.5 s and remains discernible at 720p (evidence/frames/frame-1p5s-720p.png). '2HD' is readable at both sizes; '1.44 MB' is readable at full size and marginal at 720p. The brand logo inside the black block on the label is not resolvable at either size. RQ3 therefore remains live at delivery resolution.

other_observations_on_the_real_file: No baked-in captions, watermark or burned-in timecode in any extracted frame.
Clean pre-roll: at 0.70 s the drive is empty and no hand is in frame; the disk enters around 0.95 s.
Hand and disk are both in frame roughly 0.95-3.2 s; 3.2-6.0 s is a static hold on the seated disk with no hand.

An audio stream exists (AAC LC 48 kHz stereo). It was not auditioned - no audio playback in this environment. ffmpeg volumedetect over 00:00-00:06 gives mean -42.4 dB, max -3.6 dB, so it is not silence; whether it carries speech is unverified.

review_questions.question: The acquired clip's clean insertion span is 6.0 s (00:00.00-00:06.00), below the 8-12 s preference. Accept 6 s, slow it to about 75% for ~8 s, or run past 00:06.50 which adds the eject press and the withdrawal (the opposite action)?
review_questions.update_after_acquisition: Confirmed on the real file. Drive empty and no hand at 0.70 s; disk enters about 0.95 s; seated about 3.0 s; static hold with no hand through 6.0 s; hand returns after 6.0 s and the disk is out of the drive by about 8.6-9.3 s.

review_questions.question: The clip shows a bare beige drive lying on diamond-plate metal with a warm light flare, shot at a diagonal, not a drive installed in a mid-90s PC. Acceptable for script sections 3 and 12?
review_questions.update_after_acquisition: Confirmed on the real file at full size: the drive is unmounted, sitting loose on a diamond-plate aluminium sheet, with a warm practical flare in the upper right.

review_questions.question: The disk label legibly shows 'IBM'. Pexels terms prohibit implying endorsement by brands shown. Is incidental visible trademark text acceptable here, or should the edit crop or soften the label?
review_questions.update_after_acquisition: Confirmed on the real file: 'IBM' is readable at 1920x1080 and still discernible at 1280x720. The separate brand logo block on the label is unreadable at both sizes.

review_questions.question: Mixkit 48937's free version is personal-use only. Confirm it stays excluded, or approve a paid Envato route (currently outside the no-paid-footage boundary).

gates.notes: Gate intentionally left open. Acquisition under a permissive license is not release clearance; the agent does not approve R14. Release approval comes from the OPS-04 review deck.
gates.decision: Approved: keep the asset. Rights risk accepted as documented.
